notes.title: The first game in The Jackbox Party Pack 11 is...
notes.content:
Wow! Did you hear? The Jackbox Party Pack 11 is coming to all major consoles later in 2025 with five new games! 

“But, Jackbox,” you ask, “What are those five games?” Great question, disembodied curious voice!

The first game we are revealing from The Jackbox Party Pack 11 is Suspectives! The other four games are currently a secret, but you can get some info about them in our Jackbox Direct!

[previewyoutube=YT3BXNBp-xE;full][/previewyoutube]

What is Suspectives?

Suspectives is a social deduction game where your own quirky details become evidence in a crime! Each game of Suspectives starts with some quick survey questions where every player answers questions ranging from topics like which boy band you think is the best and whether or not you can keep a houseplant alive (spoiler alert: my begonias are thriving).

The moment all answers are in, word goes out that (GASP) a crime's been committed, with one player being the secret criminal. And the only evidence to work with…? The very same answers to those surveys.

Grab your fedora and trench coat, because you and your fellow detectives need to work together to uncover which person the evidence points to with grueling interrogation sessions and lie detector reveals! And if you’re the criminal, try to blend in as a harmless detective by convincing everyone that you actually don’t have a favorite Beatle, despite that giant tattoo of Paul poking out beneath your sleeve.

How many people can play Suspectives?
4-8 players can get their sleuth on.

Around how long does one game of Suspectives take to play?
About 10-15 minutes.

Will Suspectives work with the Jackbox Megapicker?
If you are playing on Steam, all games in Party Pack 11 will work with the free Megapicker.

notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

Multiple New Game Modes
 Hilo: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
 Speed: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
 Squares: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
 Bounce: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer!
But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.



Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.

notes.title: Megapicker Update - The Naughty One
notes.content:
We've got the pedal to the floor with tires screeching towards the launch of The Jackbox Naughty Pack on Thursday, September 12th. With this being our first M for Mature title, we know some fans don't want to see these adult games in the Megapicker. We've included features to help filter out mature titles and a fun countdown timer for the launch!

Here's all the nerdy details:

This patch...

 Adds the games in The Jackbox Naughty Pack!
 Adds support for hiding/showing mature content including a little hide button that hides Naughty Pack games in the library if selected. A similar toggle in the main app menu will allow users to turn mature content back on. This is under the View setting for the Megapicker window. 
 Adds a new filter in the Game Features tab to show games with mature content
 "Unreleased" games are now supported with release date information, and a Giant Countdown that takes place 24 hours before launch
 Adds a wishlist now action for unreleased products
 Fixes a bug where some users with odd characters in their filepaths couldn't see images

What’s The Jackbox Naughty Pack? I’m so pleased you asked. Take a seat on my perfectly maintained 70s chic conversation pit couch, grab at least two friends, and get ready for an absolutely raucous game night. 

The Jackbox Naughty Pack is rated M for Mature. Watch the trailer to learn more here:

 [previewyoutube=FTAYOPKYDuU;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to play three tantalizingly silly party games, each supporting 3-8 players:

 Fakin’ It All Night Long (Social Deduction): Fakin’ It returns and this time we’re putting it all out there. Everyone gets a secret task except the Faker, who tries to blend in. Find out which of your friends is the best liar… and SO much more! Featuring new categories and a brand new “remote play” mode. 
 Dirty Drawful (Drawing, Guessing): It’s Drawful, but  dirty… It’s Dirty Drawful. We’ve taken the Drawful that you love and added spicy prompts to ensure your drawings are both terrible and titillating. We also may have added an “undo” button for this one, but don’t tell anyone. 
 Let Me Finish (Debate): Let Me Finish is Jackbox’s new presentation game that examines life’s serious questions like, “Where is the mailbox’s butt?” or “How does this avocado get aroused?” Everyone gets a chance to speak their mind but will others pick up what you’re putting down?

The Jackbox Naughty Pack will launch this Thursday, September 12, 2024 and retail for $21.69 (nice). This product will be available on all major platforms upon release.

Add it to your wishlist on Steam now!

notes.title: Megapicker Update 3
notes.content:
We didn't get these out for the weekend, but they're here now.

Based on your feedback we've made some changes to filtering and sorting!

Owned and favorited games are weighted over unowned titles in the library.  This means when you filter, you'll always see games you own before anything else.

We've received a lot of feedback on confusion surrounding filters and what's actually happening, so we've added some visual cues to help clarify things.
   - Advanced Filters will now show a count of the filters applied
   - Divider lines between items that perfectly match your filters and everything else
   - Library view returns to the top when you adjust filters

Library view now has the ability to sort by Alphabetical order instead of release date via a setting in Advanced Filters.

Fixed Issues:
[strike]- In some scenarios, games launch to the normal Party Pack loading screen as opposed directly to the title. We're actively investigating this one to better understand why. It will not have any impact on your game play, but we totally get it's pretty annoying.[/strike] -  FIXED!

[strike]- Some users are reporting issues with saved data from games like Zeeple Dome not loading when launching via The Megapicker. We are actively investigating this. [/strike] - FIXED!

Known Issues:
- The Jackbox Party Packs 1 and 2 may not always launch in full screen. We're working on a fix for that. As a workaround, you can load the Party Pack by itself, change to fullscreen mode and exit. Subsequent launches via the Megapicker will be in full screen.

Next Up:
- A fully localized build is working its way through QA!  We have some small UI elements to fix for our German friends, but hope to have it released within a week.
- Native gamepad / controller support is in active development.
- Past Games and Galleries accessible outside of jackbox.tv

Please continue to use that feedback button in The Jackbox Megapicker!

notes.title: Megapicker Weekend Update
notes.content:
What a week!  The Jackbox Megapicker and a sequel to Fakin' It?!??!  We'll let's not stop there!

We've taken your feedback seriously and have updated The Jackbox Megapicker!

Filters now include duration, player count, and Party Pack!

Choose the number of folks you're playing with and see the games that fit your group with the new Player Count filter.

Squeeze a game in before you have to leave!.  Just use the Duration filter and adjust the min and max time to hone in on the perfect game for the time you have.

Filter by Pack.  Sure, the point of the Megapicker is to show all your games regardless of which Party Pack they're in, but sometimes you still want to see what's where.  The new Advanced Filter allows you to filter your games by which Party Pack they're in so you won't make the same mistake we did by putting Trivia Murder Party 2 in Party Pack 7.

This release also includes some general bug fixes and improvements

Most notably:
- Some Windows users were unable to launch The Jackbox Megapicker a second time.  This bug has been fixed and the Megapicker will load every time.

- A small subset of Steam Deck users experienced a boot loop if they restarted their Steam Deck after launching The Jackbox Megapicker.  This has been resolved in the Megapicker.

- Properly attribute Trivia Murder Party 2 to Party Pack 6.  Woops!

Known issues:
- In some scenarios, games launch to the normal Party Pack loading screen as opposed directly to the title.  We're actively investigating this one to better understand why.  It will not have any impact on your game play, but we totally get it's pretty annoying.  

- The Jackbox Party Packs 1 and 2 may not always launch in full screen.  We're working on a fix for that.  As a workaround, you can load the Party Pack by itself, change to fullscreen mode and exit.  Subsequent launches via the Megapicker will be in full screen.

- Some users are reporting issues with saved data from games like Zeeple Dome not loading when launching via The Megapicker.  We are actively investigating this.

Next up:
- Localization!  We've received all of the strings back from our localization partners and will start getting builds through our QA process for release!
- More and/or adjustments to filters.  We're reading your feedback to better understand how you want filters to work and will be rolling out updates based on your feedback.
- Native controller support!  Editing this in because I completely forgot it and you've all be asking for it.  It's definitely in the works!
- Plenty of surprises in store!


Please continue to use that feedback button in The Jackbox Megapicker!
